facts.text: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes synthetic.
facts.why: A page opened says the telepod's copy of the steak 'tasted funny'. Nothing opened gives Veronica's exact word, so 'synthetic' could not be confirmed.
facts.fix: Veronica says the teleported steak tastes wrong.

facts.text: The Bartok press party where Seth meets Veronica.
facts.why: Wikipedia says Seth meets Veronica at a press event. The page I read does not name Bartok for that event.
facts.fix: The press party where Seth meets Veronica.

vibe.verdict: The lab, the badge and the steak test fit, but it is a polite menu for a gross film and misses the best body horror gags.
missing: Brundlefly vomiting digestive enzymes on a donut (the 'vomit drop' scene)
The Brundle Museum of Natural History in the medicine cabinet (teeth and other parts)
'Be afraid. Be very afraid.' (Veronica, to Tawny)
Seth's sugar craving and the powdered donuts (after the first teleport)
The baboon turned inside out (first test)
Veronica's nightmare of the giant maggot
ideas: Swap the note on 'Sugar dusted doughnuts' for 'Dissolved first, then eaten. Ask the chef how.'
Replace 'Steak done properly with béarnaise' with 'Control steak' and a note on the one teleported next to it.
Swap 'Candied spiced pecans' for 'Brundle's museum jar' of salted peanuts with a plastic tooth on the side.
Add 'Be afraid. Be very afraid.' as the footer line in place of the 'Return tray to the hatch' joke.
